name: order_tracking
description: Reads, adds, and updates orders in a synchronized Google Sheet and local Excel file.

read_filters.description: Filters for the 'read' action. e.g. {'Delivered': false} to find undelivered items.

new_order.description: The order data for the 'add' action. Keys must match the schema (e.g. 'Item', 'Retailer', 'Order Date').

update_data.description: The order data for the 'update' action. Must contain 'Order_Number' or 'Item' to identify the row, and the fields to update.
